hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Africa, group of islands at the northern mouth of the Mozambique Channel, about two-thirds of the way between northern Madagascar and northern Mozambique || volcanic islands, interiors vary from steep mountains to low hills || important location at northern end of Mozambique Channel; the only Arab League country that lies entirely in the Southern Hemisphere || Resources: fish || Exports: cloves, ships, essential oils, vanilla, scrap iron (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: volcanic islands, interiors vary from steep mountains to low hills || Southern Africa, group of islands at the northern mouth of the Mozambique Channel, about two-thirds of the way between northern Madagascar and northern Mozambique

climate.excerpt: tropical marine; rainy season (November to May) || cyclones possible during rainy season (December to April); volcanic activity on Grand Comore volcanism: Karthala (2,361 m) on Grand Comore Island last erupted in 2007; a 2005 eruption forced thousands of people to be evacuated and produced a large ash cloud

economy.excerpt: small trade-based island economy; declining remittances; new structural and fiscal reforms; adverse cyclone and COVID-19 impacts; manageable debts; fragile liquidity environment; large foreign direct investment; state-owned enterprises suffering || Exports: cloves, ships, essential oils, vanilla, scrap iron (2023) || Industries: fishing, tourism, perfume distillation

peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Arabic (official), French (official), Shikomoro (official; similar to Swahili), Comorian || Muslim 98.1% (overwhelmingly Sunni Muslim, small Shia Muslim and Ahmadiyya Muslim populations), ethnic religionist 1.1%, Christian 0.6%, other 0.3% (2020 est.) || Antalote, Cafre, Makoa, Oimatsaha, Sakalava
